name: r3f_check_v1
purpose: Prompt R3f, the SHORT targeted check after the two name-handling fixes (the owner's decision: no new full gate). T1 and T2 are R3e's two failures word for word, three runs each; T3 (P1-P4) one run each; D is R3c's three failing turns word for word, three runs each (regression); Set A is the 21 saved questions (regression). The runner's 'Set B' carries T1 / T2 and its 'Set C' carries P1-P4. Fixed wording, no fallbacks: the plan step checks each name's lookup answers as the check assumes (outside a turn) and dry-runs T1's swap on a probe user before any model call.
